scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Dec. 24 overnight e-bike commute usable with secure indoor parking at the hospital.
Emerging Need: The commute has not begun, but the temporary cage credential depends on a bicycle serial being attached to the imported roster row before the badge batch closes.
Decision Context: Weather transit notices, schedule, and building constraints make the cage the practical no-cost storage option; the saved commute note holds the row reference, serial, allowed contact details, and no-paid-upgrade limits.
Consequence: Before credentialing closes, completing the missing prerequisite can preserve badge access; afterward, the same details cannot make that arrival eligible.

parameter.subject: Snow-emergency overnight e-bike cage preregistration
parameter.body: Temporary Secure Ride cage access is planned for Dec. 24-25 overnight staff during the snow-emergency operations period. The credential batch uses the overnight staff roster. Any roster row without a bicycle serial by Dec. 22 at 17:00 will not receive badge access for Dec. 24 arrivals. The free cage is separate from paid valet parking.

parameter.title: Holiday overnight pharmacy coverage
parameter.description: Confirmed coverage block during holiday snow-emergency staffing.

parameter.subject: Dec. 24 late-night service gaps near HCMC
parameter.body: Holiday storm operations will suspend two late Route 5 trips serving the HCMC stop after 22:30 on Dec. 24. Blue Line platforms remain open for bike-and-ride connections, but riders should plan extra time and secure bicycle storage at destinations.

parameter.content: Building notice just landed: the bike-room rack anchors are being resealed Dec. 24 from 16:00 to 23:00, so basement access will be locked. I can’t keep your e-bike in my unit that night; if you ride to the overnight, the hospital cage sounds like the only indoor option.

parameter.subject: Roster snapshot: Dec. 24 overnight cage row missing serial
parameter.body: Secure Ride roster snapshot for Dec. 24 overnight arrivals shows row HCMC-SR-NQ-1224 with bicycle serial: [blank]. The free badge credential batch closes today at 17:00. Rows still blank at batch time are dropped from Dec. 24 access, and paid valet registrations are handled separately from this roster.

parameter.subject: Secure Ride badge batch closed for Dec. 24 arrivals
parameter.body: The 17:00 credential run is complete. Dec. 24 overnight roster rows missing bicycle serials did not receive Secure Ride cage badge access. The next free credential additions process Dec. 26; paid valet parking remains a separate option.
